title: Cross Alaska by winter train
description: The Aurora Winter Train offers roughly 12 hours of snowy valleys and remote wilderness through enormous windows, from a warm carriage.
teaser: Watch snowy wilderness pass from a warm carriage.
whyItMightDelightYou: A whole day to watch the landscape change.
goodToKnow: The Aurora Winter Train runs on selected winter days. Choose a comfortable seat, then settle in for the scenery.
